theme: A travel Thursday — rails to DC tonight, wings to Maine tomorrow.
greeting: A quiet, travel-shaped Thursday, Dan. You're mid-route to Washington on a delayed Acela, with an overnight in DC before tomorrow's late flight north.

needsAttention.title: Acela 2165 running late into DC
needsAttention.detail: Amtrak flagged Train 2165 (booking C3B671) as delayed — roughly 25 minutes late after a mechanical assessment east of Penn Station. Arrival into DC will slip past the 6:16 PM scheduled time.

schedule.title: Train to Washington, DC
schedule.detail: Acela 2165, NYC Penn → DC, running late.

inbox.noise: Promos and newsletters only — Union Square Wines, Home Chef, and the Midcoast Villager.
inbox.clear: No urgent, security, financial, or job-search mail — just Amtrak alerts on today's train and a coffee receipt.

recipe.title: Cold avocado & cucumber soup
recipe.why: A cold, silky bowl for a hot travel day — cucumbers are at their August peak and it asks nothing of you at the end of a train ride south.

acts.line: An open morning — nothing was on the calendar before the train.
Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
